Compiled as a library target (-T lib_6_3), which is what triggers the bug:
the entry function `main` is `[shader("hull")]` and never touches groupshared
`gs` itself; only its patch-constant function `HSPatch` does.

- `dxc_1_6_2112` (CE's oldest DXC): exits 0 and prints a full DXIL module --
  the groupshared read inside HSPatch (`addrspace(3)` loads of `gs`) reaches
  final DXIL and is never flagged, even though the shader is not a compute
  shader and TGSM access is illegal there. This is the reported bug.
- `dxc_trunk`: fails with "validation errors" / "Thread Group Shared Memory
  not supported from non-compute entry points", attributing the error to the
  `HSPatch` function specifically -- the validator now checks the
  patch-constant function too, not only the [shader("hull")] entry point.
